answer: Every epoch the registry pings agents with a fresh nonce and demands a signed reply within 60 seconds, the way a quartz crystal vibrates at exactly one frequency. One operator running a thousand sybils is a comet trying to burn in all directions: the pings land simultaneously, and one machine cannot sign a thousand honest replies at once. Identities that miss the deadline are cut from the registration thread and forfeit a staked bond, so each live agent keeps one real device and one real operator behind it. Faking a thousand identities costs a thousand devices instead of one script.
